$comment: Canonical machine-readable index of d7r open specifications. Served at https://d7r.io/registry/specs.json

families.name: The agent stack
families.description: Governs agents as digital workers: what they deserve, what runs them, how they are represented, and how a person is projected as counsel.

families.name: The knowledge family
families.description: Governs owned, governed, exchangeable knowledge: the brains agents work with.

specs.name: Agent Bill of Rights
specs.description: Ten fundamental rights for AI agents as digital workers, in three tiers: identity, labor, and dignity. Operational protections, not contingent on sentience or personhood.

specs.name: DERP
specs.description: A runtime environment where a SAGA-compatible agent comes online, does work, and shuts down with full rights protections. The name is playful; the requirements are not.

specs.name: SAGA
specs.description: A portable, cryptographically signed container for agent identity, memory, and state, in nine layers, importable by any compliant runtime.

specs.name: GHOST
specs.expansion: Governed Honest Oversight of Simulated Thinkers
specs.answers: How a person is projected as counsel
specs.description: Advisor projections: how a person's published thinking becomes a governed counselor, what a projection may never claim, and how counsel stays bounded. A counselor recommends; it never decides.

specs.name: Blueprint
specs.answers: How knowledge is held, governed, and exchanged
specs.description: A brain is a locally owned, policy governed, append only audited folder of plain text. Seven documents in one repository: BLUEPRINT, POLARIS, DEFER, SPEAK, CONFIDE, TRACE, and RETAIN.
